description: Join a specific (non-home) lot, leaving the current lot. On the wire this is: `FindLotRequest(LotId=<target_lot_location>, OpenIfClosed=true)` → `FindLotResponse` (ticket + host address) → a new Aries connection to the lot server → `RequestClientSessionResponse(ServiceIdent="JLT")` → `JoinLotWithTransitionRequest(LotTransitionInfo{...})`. The city socket is reused; only the lot socket is rebuilt. On success you arrive at `(AvatarLotTilePosX, AvatarLotTilePosY)` facing `AvatarDirection`. Prerequisite: you have a live city connection and the target is NOT closed-roommate-only (or you are an invited visitor). IMPORTANT — `target_lot_location` is the lot **location code** (24-bit coordinate packing, the same value `avatar.LotLocation` returns from `AvatarDataServlet`), NOT the DB lot_id. OQ-3 locked this aliasing trap. Effect (when implemented): the bot's VM + perception projector + lot Aries socket are all torn down and rebuilt; a new perception stream opens on the new lot; the motive delta window resets because deltas across two different lot contexts are meaningless. Cost: one full lot-join handshake latency (~10s worst case). STATUS: deferred in current session — HeadlessLotConnection has no reconnect primitive today (see its doc: "No reconnect logic — OQ-11 punted to a follow-up item"). Calling this op returns `ok:false` with `deferred:true` and an error string pointing at the follow-up (`freesoexperiment-ca0`). Your bot state is unchanged. Agents: if you need to be on a specific lot, pass `FSO_LOT_LOCATION=0x<hex>` at bot startup for now.
